test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of 25 numbers is 54. The average of the first 13 numbers and that of the last 13 numbers is 52.8 and 62.2, respectively. If the 13th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Given:**

The average of twenty-five numbers is 54

The average of the first 13 numbers is 52.8

The average of the last 13 numbers is 62.2

**Concept used:**

Average = sum of the observation/Number of the observation

**Calculation:**

Sum of the 25 numbers = 54 × 25 = 1350

Sum of the first 13 numbers
